name: When should a new dental practice consider investing in GEO visibility?

mainEntity.name: When should a new dental practice consider investing in GEO visibility?

acceptedAnswer.text: A new dental practice should consider investing in GEO visibility from the very beginning, ideally even before opening its doors. Establishing a strong local online presence early on is crucial for attracting initial patients and building a reputation. Without effective GEO strategies, a new practice risks being invisible to potential patients who rely on online searches to find local services. Early investment ensures the practice can compete effectively from day one in its local market.
acceptedAnswer.description: New dental practices should invest in GEO visibility before opening to attract initial patients and ensure competitiveness in the local market.
